Subject: Vendor portal cutover & ephemeral credential choreography

Hi Rohan —

We’re planning the migration of Helio’s vendor profile into Vendr next week and wanted to confirm a few security details before we cutover. Current asks from our security and procurement teams: 

- A presign manifest (list of files + expected hashes) for any evidence we’ll upload during the cutover window.
- TTL and scope for ephemeral S3 upload credentials you plan to mint (we prefer <= 2 hours, scoped to manifest prefix).
- A short attestation of evidence ownership post-upload: who at Redwood signs custody/possession for the next 90 days (we require a named contact and backup).
- CAIQ mapping doc — we can attach a targeted CAIQ fragment if you can map which fields are covered by the uploaded artifacts.

Can you confirm these items and the earliest available upload window? We’re aiming for Thurs 10/21 in US-PST if that works.

Thanks,
Sam Torres

Helio Payments

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor portal cutover & ephemeral credential choreography — presign & temp creds

Rohan / team / Sam —

Draft answers below (I’ll attach the presign-manifest.csv and the IAM policy snippet):

1) Presign manifest: We want a CSV with columns: relative_path, filename, sha256, size_bytes, upload_prefix. We’ll validate hashes on ingest and reject mismatches. I attached presign-manifest.csv (stub) for Helio to fill.

2) Temp credentials: We will issue STS-based upload credentials scoped to a single prefix (s3://redwood-vendr/helio/{manifest_prefix}/). Default TTL: 2 hours (7200s). We can support as short as 1 hour on request. The generated policy will only allow PutObject for the manifest-listed keys plus PutObjectAcl:private.

3) Upload window: chunking recommendation — 30 minute batches (max 500 files per chunk) to avoid long-lived stacks and to speed verification. For large files (>200MB) we’ll request multipart upload with a signed URL approach; still limited by the same prefix/timebox.

4) Post-upload verification: we’ll run an automated hash-check, run CAIQ-file mapping (append caiq-mapping.xlsx), and then set an evidence ownership marker in Vendr.

Attachments included: presign-manifest.csv (stub), s3-tempcreds-policy.pdf (IAM snippet), caiq-mapping.xlsx (mapping template).

Irene — for the attestation block we need a named owner and an alternate backup; please add language for legal signature and retention policy.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: presign-manifest.csv (stub); s3-tempcreds-policy.pdf

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. We’re good to support Thu 2027-10-21 as the upload window. Summary of what you’ll receive from us by EOD Tue 10/19: 

- presign-manifest.csv (template) for Helio to populate with file paths + sha256 (see attached stub).
- s3 temporary credential policy + recommended TTL (default 2 hours; can be shortened to 1 hour on request).
- 1-par attestation template for evidence ownership: named owner (Rohan Mehta) + backup (Marissa Cole), custody asserted for 90 days post-upload; retention note and contact+escalation.
- CAIQ mapping template (caiq-mapping.xlsx) for you to fill and return; we’ll append field coverage after verification.

Operational notes: we will validate manifest hashes after each 30-minute chunk; any mismatches will be placed into a quarantine prefix and we’ll request re-upload of only mismatched artifacts. Multipart uploads are supported for files >200MB; we’ll provide a separate signed-URL flow for those (still TTL-limited).

Please confirm you’re comfortable with the 30-minute chunking cadence and the default 2 hour TTL. If yes, fill and return the manifest by Wed 10/20 17:00 PST so we can pre-provision prefixes and IAM roles.
